links.outcome: Endoscopist adenoma and polyp detection rates without CAD, before versus after CAD introduction
links.effect: Without CAD, ADR fell from 31.6% to 13.5% (p<0.001) and PDR from 39.8% to 18.2% (p<0.001) after CAD introduction, suggesting reliance on CAD and lapses in independent detection.
links.quote: ADR (31.6% vs. 13.5%, p < 0.001) and PDR (39.8% vs. 18.2%, p < 0.001) were significantly lower in the post-intervention non-CAD group than in the pre-intervention non-CAD group.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating the real-world deployment impact of computer-aided detection (CAD) in colonoscopy, examining both benefits (ADR/PDR) and drawbacks (deskilling/inattention when CAD is not available).
